title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Ansible automation portal Red Hat Enterprise Linux Images
description: CVE-2026-116576 is a command injection vulnerability in the systeminformation library used by Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform 2.3's Ansible Automation Portal bootable container image. On Windows systems, improper input sanitization fails to filter Unicode quotation marks in PowerShell commands, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the Node.js process. This vulnerability does not affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux environments as the vulnerable PowerShell code path is not executed there. Exploitation requires forwarding untrusted input to specific functions and is limited to Windows Node.js applications using this library.
